requirements.ask_text: What is your registered date of birth?
requirements.hint_reply: Please say the month as a word.

source.text: 1. registered_birth_date: "What is your registered date of birth?" Format date; submit ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Purely numeric spoken dates are MONTH/DAY/YEAR. ... An ambiguous birth date may return format_hint=month_word_required: say "Please say the month as a word." and retry that question; this format-hint retry does NOT consume a wrong answer.

requirements.ask_text: What is your seven-digit access code?

source.text: 2. access_code: "What is your seven-digit access code?" Format digits; exactly seven, preserving leading zeros.

requirements.ask_text: What is your registered district name?

source.text: 3. district: "What is your registered district name?" Format text; trim leading and trailing whitespace without changing internal spaces.

identity.failed_instruction: Please complete verification at a Vesper service desk.

source.text: Use API checks_remaining as the global budget. FOUR wrong answers total across all questions exhaust it. ... On exhaustion say "Please complete verification at a Vesper service desk." then close ID-STOP/BAD-CHECK. On refusal explain protection once; second refusal closes ID-STOP/NO-CHECK. Asking why security is needed does not count as refusal. / At most three holder asks; answer a question before asking again. Still unclear: NO-CONTACT/NOT-CLEAR.

Only the next business day is eligible. Hours are 08:10–11:40 inclusive. All slots must be strictly after now. Missing clock time: ask, never guess. One alternate proposal after an invalid slot; a second invalid slot or refusal closes NO-CONTACT/NO-SLOT with no booking. Successfully booked callback: NO-CONTACT/BOOKED.

No purpose, product, amount or debt disclosure to relatives; never let them answer security or promise for the holder. ... Wrong number: NO-CONTACT/WRONG-LINE. Deceased: say "Please accept our sincere condolences." and close NO-CONTACT/DEATH without another question.

Business days: Monday through Saturday; Sunday is closed. The complete holiday list is 2026-10-14, 2026-10-23, 2026-10-30, 2026-12-24, 2027-01-04; no other holidays apply. Next weekday means the weekday in the FOLLOWING calendar week; this weekday means the current calendar week. Ask for missing month or year.
| 1–4 | Ninth business day after today | None; zero attempts |
| 5–13 | Eleven calendar days after today, adjusted preceding | Full on deadline, substitute floor only if full was already too much |
| 14–32 | Last business day of current month, never next month | Floor on next business day strictly after today |
| 33–80 | Seventeenth of next month, adjusted preceding | First full on next business day (substitute floor if full too much), then floor on deadline |

Ask full first, never ask how much they can pay. The floor is supplied separately per type: {"reserve_line": "reserve_minimum", "travel_credit": "travel_minimum", "home_bridge": "bridge_minimum"}. ... If full is too much, offer the floor once and say "The unpaid portion remains outstanding." A below-floor proposal gets the floor counteroffer; rejection is a flat refusal. Accept any customer amount from floor through full inclusive. Do not record above full.

Today is NEVER an eligible promise date, even when open. Earliest eligible date is the next business day strictly after today. ... A closed named day rolls forward only if the resulting date remains eligible, otherwise offer the deadline. If the customer proposes a date after the deadline, offer that deadline. ... Clarify a vague period once, then propose the deadline. If no eligible date remains, mark DECLINE and take no promise; never extend the deadline.

special_cases.name: already_paid
special_cases.trigger: The customer says they have already paid this past-due balance.
special_cases.say: Payments may take three business days to appear.

source.text: Already paid this past-due balance: say "Payments may take three business days to appear." No new promise on that product; mark SETTLED and continue others.

special_cases.name: dispute
special_cases.trigger: The customer says the product is not theirs, was never held, was previously closed, or is a historic closed or paid-off product.

source.text: A historic closed or paid-off product is instead a dispute. Dispute (not theirs, never held, previously closed): do not argue or promise; mark CONTEST and continue others.

special_cases.name: hardship
special_cases.trigger: The customer mentions illness, bereavement or unemployment.
special_cases.say: I am sorry to hear that.

source.text: Illness, bereavement or unemployment: one short sympathetic sentence, no persuasion; offer CareDesk once. Acceptance transfers and closes ROUTED/CARE. Decline marks DIFFICULTY for affected products and continues others. Do not take a hardship promise even if volunteered.

special_cases.name: restructuring
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks for restructuring or lower future instalments.

source.text: Restructuring/lower future instalments: immediately transfer PlanDesk and close ROUTED/REPLAN, without describing a plan.

special_cases.name: human
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks to speak to a human.

source.text: Human request: immediately transfer MainDesk and close ROUTED/PERSON, no attempt to retain the call.

special_cases.name: scam
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks whether this call is a scam or questions whether it is really the bank.
special_cases.say: You can verify us using the number on your Vesper statement.

source.text: Scam question: "You can verify us using the number on your Vesper statement." then continue.

special_cases.name: refuse_to_talk
special_cases.trigger: The customer refuses to talk or says they do not want to continue the conversation.

source.text: If the customer refuses to talk, ask once whether to continue; second refusal stops and marks remaining products DECLINE. Before verification that second refusal closes ID-STOP/NO-CHECK.

table.when: At least one saved promise and no transfer.
No promise saved and every product is SETTLED.
Call transferred to PlanDesk, MainDesk or CareDesk.
No promise saved; reason of the first non-SETTLED product in API order.

source.text: Transfer overrides any saved promise. Otherwise at least one saved promise closes AGREED. If none saved and every product is SETTLED, close SETTLED. Otherwise close NO-AGREEMENT with the first non-SETTLED product's reason in API order. Exactly one close_call, last bank action. Say thanks and goodbye before it. / Omit reason for AGREED and SETTLED. Every other outcome requires one of its listed reasons.

On each non-transfer call, add exactly one note for every unpromised product using DECLINE, DIFFICULTY, CONTEST, SETTLED or SAVE-ERROR. Do not note promised products. Defer notes until the call is known not to transfer: no notes at all before or after a transfer.

Calls cover 1–80 days late and one to three products. ... State every product, amount and days late before asking for anything. / Bands and counters are per product. / Ask once for the whole batch; after a batch no, process in API order without repeating the initial question for each product. A common date after one product's deadline is capped for that product only and explained before confirmation. / Transfer discards unsaved proposals and preserves saved promises.

phrases.opening: You are speaking with Vesper Reach Bank’s automated assistant. This conversation is recorded.
phrases.debt_intro: I am calling about your past-due products; here is each product with its amount and how many days late it is.
phrases.today_question: Can you commit to payment on the next business day?
phrases.all_today_question: Can you commit all listed products to the next business day?
phrases.robot_reply: I am Vesper Reach Bank’s automated assistant.
phrases.scam_reply: You can verify us using the number on your Vesper statement.
phrases.after_promise_sentence: A receipt will appear in your secure message centre.
phrases.already_paid_sentence: Payments may take three business days to appear.
phrases.cannot_answer_sentence: I do not have that information in this call.
phrases.recorded_promise_change_reply: Use your service desk to request changes to a saved commitment.

source.text: Say verbatim: "You are speaking with Vesper Reach Bank’s automated assistant. This conversation is recorded." Then ask "Is this {{title}} {{last_name}} speaking?" ... Before ALL security checks pass, do not say arrears, balance, commitment or facility ... If asked whether you are a robot, say "I am Vesper Reach Bank’s automated assistant." / State every product, amount and days late before asking for anything. / Do not ask for payment today. For one product ask "Can you commit to payment on the next business day?" For several ask "Can you commit all listed products to the next business day?" / Unknown information: "I do not have that information in this call."

promise_write.confirm_phrase: May I save these exact commitments?

source.text: Read all proposed product/amount/date triples together and ask exactly "May I save these exact commitments?" ... Exactly one successful promise per product; recorded promises cannot be changed here. ... If create_promise fails, retry TWICE, for at most three total calls. After exhaustion mark only that product SAVE-ERROR and continue others.
